tools.seo_title: BMR Calculator - Basal Metabolic Rate | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) easily to plan your diet. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates Basal Metabolic Rate using weight (kg), height (cm), and age based on Mifflin-St Jeor.
tools.formula_description_zh: 使用 Mifflin-St Jeor 公式，根據體重(kg)、身高(cm)與年齡計算基礎代謝率。

faq.q: What is Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR)?
faq.a: BMR is the number of calories your body needs to accomplish its most basic life-sustaining functions at rest.

faq.q: How accurate is the Mifflin-St Jeor equation?
faq.a: The Mifflin-St Jeor equation is considered one of the most accurate methods for estimating BMR in healthy adults.

faq.q: Can I use BMR to lose weight?
faq.a: Yes, knowing your BMR helps you determine your total daily energy expenditure (TDEE) to create a safe calorie deficit.

tools.seo_title: Lean Body Mass Calculator - LBM Formula | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your Lean Body Mass (LBM) using the Boer formula. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try our free tool today!
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates Lean Body Mass based on weight (kg) and height (cm) using the Boer formula.
tools.formula_description_zh: 使用 Boer 公式，根據體重（公斤）和身高（公分）計算去脂體重（LBM）。

faq.q: What is Lean Body Mass (LBM)?
faq.a: Lean Body Mass is the difference between your total body weight and your body fat weight. It includes muscles, bones, organs, and water.

faq.q: Why is the Boer formula used for LBM?
faq.a: The Boer formula is widely used because it provides a highly accurate estimation of lean body mass based on height and weight for both men and women.

faq.q: How does LBM differ from muscle mass?
faq.a: LBM includes all non-fat components of your body, such as organs, bones, and water, whereas muscle mass refers strictly to the weight of your muscles.

tools.seo_title: Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator - Check Health Risk
tools.seo_description: Calculate your Waist-to-Hip Ratio (WHR) to assess health risks. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: WHR is calculated by dividing waist circumference by hip circumference to assess abdominal obesity.
tools.formula_description_zh: 腰臀比是將腰圍除以臀圍，用於評估腹部肥胖及相關健康風險。

faq.q: What is a healthy waist-to-hip ratio?
faq.a: According to the WHO, a healthy WHR is 0.9 or less for men and 0.85 or less for women. Higher ratios indicate abdominal obesity.

faq.q: Why is waist-to-hip ratio important?
faq.a: WHR is a strong indicator of overall health and risk of developing serious conditions like heart disease and type 2 diabetes.

faq.q: How do I measure my waist and hips correctly?
faq.a: Measure your waist at the narrowest part just above your belly button, and your hips at the widest part of your buttocks.

tools.seo_title: Body Surface Area Calculator - BSA | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your Body Surface Area (BSA) easily. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates body surface area using the Du Bois formula based on height in cm and weight in kg.
tools.formula_description_zh: 使用 Du Bois 公式，根據身高（公分）和體重（公斤）計算體表面積。

faq.q: What is Body Surface Area (BSA)?
faq.a: BSA is the measured or calculated surface area of a human body, often used in clinical settings to determine medication dosages.

faq.q: Why is the Du Bois formula used?
faq.a: The Du Bois formula is one of the most widely used and validated methods for estimating BSA in both adults and children.

faq.q: Is BSA the same as BMI?
faq.a: No, BMI measures body fat based on height and weight, while BSA measures the total surface area of the body.

tools.seo_title: Maximum Heart Rate Calculator | Free MHR Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your maximum heart rate easily. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try our free MHR calculator today!
tools.formula_description_en: The Tanaka formula estimates maximum heart rate more accurately for older adults than 220-age.
tools.formula_description_zh: Tanaka公式比傳統的220-年齡更能準確估算中老年人的最大心率。

faq.q: What is a good maximum heart rate for my age?
faq.a: Maximum heart rate varies by age. A common estimate is 220 minus your age, but the Tanaka formula (208 - 0.7 x age) is often more accurate.

faq.q: Is it safe to reach my maximum heart rate?
faq.a: Reaching your maximum heart rate during intense exercise is generally safe for healthy individuals, but consult a doctor if you have heart conditions.

faq.q: How long can I stay at my maximum heart rate?
faq.a: You can typically only sustain your true maximum heart rate for a very short period, usually a few minutes at most, due to extreme fatigue.

tools.seo_title: TDEE Calculator - Total Daily Energy Expenditure
tools.seo_description: Calculate your Total Daily Energy Expenditure. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try our free TDEE calculator today!
secondary_keywords: how many calories to maintain weight
tools.formula_description_en: TDEE is calculated by multiplying your Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) by a specific activity factor.
tools.formula_description_zh: TDEE 是透過將您的基礎代謝率 (BMR) 乘以特定的活動係數來計算得出。

faq.q: What is TDEE?
faq.a: TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure) is the total number of calories you burn in a day, including resting metabolism and physical activity.

faq.q: How do I use my TDEE for weight loss?
faq.a: To lose weight, you should consume fewer calories than your TDEE. A common approach is a deficit of 300-500 calories per day.

faq.q: Does TDEE change on rest days?
faq.a: Yes, your actual energy expenditure is lower on rest days. However, TDEE calculators usually average your activity over the week.

tools.seo_title: Calorie Deficit Calculator - Weight Loss | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your calorie deficit for weight loss. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional before starting any diet.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates the difference between Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) and daily calorie intake.
tools.formula_description_zh: 計算每日總能量消耗（TDEE）與每日熱量攝取之間的差值，用於評估減重進度。

faq.q: What is a safe calorie deficit for weight loss?
faq.a: A safe and sustainable calorie deficit is generally 500 calories per day, which leads to about 0.5 kg (1 lb) of weight loss per week.

faq.q: Can I have a calorie deficit without exercising?
faq.a: Yes, you can achieve a calorie deficit by reducing your food intake alone, though combining diet with exercise is often more effective and healthier.

faq.q: Why am I not losing weight in a calorie deficit?
faq.a: You might be underestimating your calorie intake, overestimating your TDEE, or experiencing water retention. Consult a healthcare professional for personalized advice.

tools.seo_title: Calorie Calculator - Daily Caloric Needs | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your daily calorie needs for weight loss, gain, or maintenance. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Adjusts TDEE by subtracting 500 kcal for weight loss or adding 300 kcal for weight gain.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據總熱量消耗(TDEE)調整，減重每日減少500大卡，增重每日增加300大卡。

faq.q: How many calories should I eat to lose weight?
faq.a: A general rule is to consume 500 calories less than your Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) to lose about 1 pound per week.

faq.q: Is it safe to eat less than 1200 calories a day?
faq.a: It is generally not recommended to consume fewer than 1,200 calories for women or 1,500 for men without medical supervision.

faq.q: Should I adjust my calories on workout days?
faq.a: Your TDEE already accounts for your average activity level, but you may need slightly more calories on intense training days.

tools.seo_title: Meal Calorie Calculator - Track Your Food | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate calories in your meals easily. Track your food intake. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Sums the calories of all ingredients based on their weight and caloric density per 100g.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據每種食材的重量和每100克的熱量密度，加總計算出整餐的總熱量。

faq.q: How accurate is this meal calorie calculator?
faq.a: It is highly accurate if you weigh your ingredients raw and use reliable nutritional databases. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.

faq.q: Should I weigh my food raw or cooked?
faq.a: It is generally recommended to weigh food raw, as cooking methods can change water content and affect the weight without changing the calories.

faq.q: Does this calculator account for cooking oils?
faq.a: You must add cooking oils and sauces as separate ingredients, as they are highly calorically dense and significantly impact the total meal calories.

tools.seo_title: Calories Burned Calculator - Track Workout | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate calories burned during exercise. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try our free tool today!
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates energy expenditure based on Metabolic Equivalent of Task (MET), weight, and duration.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據任務代謝當量（MET）、體重和運動持續時間計算能量消耗。

faq.q: How accurate is the calories burned calculator?
faq.a: It provides a good estimate based on MET values, but individual factors like age, fitness level, and body composition can affect actual calories burned.

faq.q: What is a MET value?
faq.a: MET stands for Metabolic Equivalent of Task. It is a ratio of your working metabolic rate relative to your resting metabolic rate.

faq.q: Can I use this for any type of exercise?
faq.a: Yes, as long as you know the MET value for the specific activity, you can calculate the estimated calories burned.

tools.seo_title: 1RM Calculator - Find Your One Rep Max | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your one rep max (1RM) to optimize strength training. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional before starting.
tools.formula_description_en: The Epley formula estimates 1RM based on the weight lifted and the number of repetitions performed.
tools.formula_description_zh: Epley公式根據舉起的重量和重複次數來估算最大單次舉重重量（1RM）。

faq.q: How accurate is the 1RM calculator?
faq.a: The Epley formula provides a good estimate, but accuracy decreases if you perform more than 10 reps. It is best used for 1-10 rep ranges.

faq.q: Why is knowing my 1RM important?
faq.a: Knowing your 1RM helps you design effective strength training programs by allowing you to lift specific percentages of your max for different goals.

faq.q: Is it safe to test my actual 1RM?
faq.a: Testing a true 1RM can be risky, especially for beginners. Using a calculator with a submaximal weight is a safer alternative to estimate your max.

tools.seo_title: Running Pace Calculator - Calculate Pace & Speed | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your running pace and speed easily. Plan your training and races. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Pace is calculated by dividing total time by distance. Speed is distance divided by time.
tools.formula_description_zh: 配速是將總時間除以距離計算得出。速度則是距離除以時間。

faq.q: How do I calculate my running pace?
faq.a: Divide your total running time by the distance covered. For example, running 5km in 25 minutes gives a pace of 5:00 min/km.

faq.q: What is a good running pace for beginners?
faq.a: A good beginner pace is typically between 6:00 and 7:30 min/km, but it varies based on age, fitness level, and terrain.

faq.q: Is it better to train by pace or heart rate?
faq.a: Both are valuable. Pace helps you hit race goals, while heart rate ensures you are training in the right intensity zones.

tools.seo_title: VO2 Max Calculator - Test Aerobic Fitness | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your VO2 Max with the Cooper Test. Improve aerobic fitness. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Estimates VO2 max based on the distance covered in 12 minutes of running or walking.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據12分鐘內跑步或步行的距離來估算最大攝氧量（VO2 Max）。

faq.q: What is a good VO2 max score?
faq.a: A good VO2 max varies by age and gender, but generally, a score above 40 ml/kg/min is considered good for most adults.

faq.q: How can I improve my VO2 max?
faq.a: You can improve your VO2 max through high-intensity interval training (HIIT), consistent aerobic exercise, and endurance running.

faq.q: Is the Cooper Test accurate for VO2 max?
faq.a: The Cooper Test provides a reliable estimate of VO2 max for most people, though clinical lab testing is the most accurate method.

tools.seo_title: Workout Volume Calculator - Track Training Load | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your workout volume easily. Optimize training load. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional before starting.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates total workout volume by multiplying sets, repetitions, and weight lifted per exercise.
tools.formula_description_zh: 透過將每項運動的組數、次數和舉起重量相乘來計算總訓練量。

faq.q: Why is tracking workout volume important?
faq.a: Tracking volume helps ensure progressive overload, which is essential for muscle hypertrophy and strength gains over time.

faq.q: Should I include warm-up sets in my volume calculation?
faq.a: Generally, only working sets are included in volume calculations, as warm-up sets do not provide the same stimulus for muscle growth.

faq.q: Is workout volume the only metric I should track?
faq.a: No, while volume is important, you should also consider intensity, frequency, and recovery to optimize your training program.

tools.seo_title: Target Heart Rate Calculator - Find Your Zone | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your target heart rate zones for optimal training. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional before starting any routine.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates target heart rate using the Karvonen formula based on maximum and resting heart rates.
tools.formula_description_zh: 使用卡沃能公式，根據最大心率和靜息心率計算目標心率區間，幫助優化訓練強度。

faq.q: What is a good target heart rate for fat burn?
faq.a: For fat burning, you should aim for 60-70% of your maximum heart rate. This zone primarily uses fat for energy. Always consult a doctor before starting.

faq.q: How do I find my resting heart rate?
faq.a: Measure your pulse for 60 seconds first thing in the morning before getting out of bed. A normal resting heart rate for adults ranges from 60 to 100 bpm.

faq.q: Why is the Karvonen formula better?
faq.a: The Karvonen formula factors in your resting heart rate, providing a more personalized and accurate target heart rate zone compared to basic age-based formulas.

tools.seo_title: Weight Loss Calculator - Plan Your Goal | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate how long it takes to reach your weight loss goal. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try our free tool today!
tools.formula_source: Standard Energy Balance Equation (1 kg fat ≈ 7700 kcal)
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates weeks to reach target weight based on daily calorie deficit, assuming 7700 kcal per kg.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據每日熱量赤字計算達到目標體重所需的週數，假設每公斤體脂肪約含 7700 大卡。

faq.q: How accurate is this weight loss calculator?
faq.a: It provides an estimate based on the standard rule that 1 kg of fat equals 7700 kcal. Actual results may vary due to metabolism and water weight.

faq.q: What is a safe daily calorie deficit?
faq.a: A safe and sustainable deficit is generally 500 to 750 kcal per day, leading to about 0.5 to 1 kg of weight loss per week.

faq.q: Why am I not losing weight despite a calorie deficit?
faq.a: Factors like water retention, muscle gain, inaccurate calorie tracking, or metabolic adaptation can affect the scale. Consistency is key.

tools.seo_title: Macro Calculator - Track Your Macros | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your daily macros for weight loss or muscle gain. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try it now!
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates daily protein, fat, and carbohydrate needs based on body weight and total calorie goals.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據體重和總熱量目標，計算每日所需的蛋白質、脂肪和碳水化合物克數。

faq.q: What is the best macro ratio for weight loss?
faq.a: A common macro ratio for weight loss is 40% protein, 30% fat, and 30% carbs, but it varies by individual. Always consult a healthcare professional.

faq.q: How much protein do I need daily?
faq.a: For active individuals, 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight is recommended to maintain or build muscle mass.

faq.q: Can I adjust my macros on rest days?
faq.a: Yes, some people reduce carbohydrate intake on rest days while keeping protein high, but consistency is key for long-term results.

tools.seo_title: Intermittent Fasting Calculator - Plan Fasting Window
tools.seo_description: Plan your eating window with our Intermittent Fasting Calculator. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional before fasting.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates daily calorie intake during the eating window based on TDEE and weight goals.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據總熱量消耗(TDEE)與體重目標，計算進食窗口期間的每日建議熱量攝取。

faq.q: What is the best intermittent fasting schedule for beginners?
faq.a: The 16:8 method is highly recommended for beginners. It involves fasting for 16 hours and eating during an 8-hour window, which is sustainable and effective for weight management.

faq.q: Does drinking water or black coffee break my fast?
faq.a: No, plain water, black coffee, and unsweetened tea contain zero calories and will not break your fast. They can actually help suppress appetite during fasting hours.

faq.q: Can I exercise while fasting?
faq.a: Yes, exercising while fasting is generally safe and may increase fat burning. However, listen to your body and consider lighter workouts if you feel dizzy or fatigued.

tools.seo_title: Body Weight Planner - Plan Your Weight Loss | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Use our Body Weight Planner to map your goals. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates weight loss timeline considering metabolic adaptation using the NIH model.
tools.formula_description_zh: 使用 NIH 模型計算減重時間表，並考慮代謝適應因素。

faq.q: What is metabolic adaptation?
faq.a: Metabolic adaptation is the process where your body slows down its resting metabolic rate in response to weight loss and calorie restriction.

faq.q: Why is the NIH Body Weight Planner different?
faq.a: Unlike standard calculators, it accounts for metabolic changes that occur during weight loss, providing a more realistic timeline.

faq.q: Is this tool suitable for medical advice?
faq.a: No, this tool is for informational purposes only. Always consult a healthcare professional before starting any weight loss program.

tools.seo_title: Fat Loss Calculator - Plan Your Weight Loss | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate fat loss and time needed to reach your target body fat. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try it now!
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates fat mass to lose and estimated time based on 7700 kcal per kg of fat deficit.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據每公斤脂肪約7700大卡的熱量赤字，計算需減去的脂肪量及預估時間。

faq.q: How accurate is the fat loss calculator?
faq.a: It provides an estimate based on the standard 7700 kcal per kg of fat rule. Individual metabolism and water weight fluctuations may affect actual results.

faq.q: What is a safe daily calorie deficit?
faq.a: A safe and sustainable daily calorie deficit is typically between 300 to 500 kcal, leading to a gradual fat loss of about 0.5 kg per week.

faq.q: Can I target fat loss in specific areas?
faq.a: No, spot reduction is a myth. Your body loses fat systemically based on genetics and overall calorie deficit.

tools.seo_title: Protein Intake Calculator - Daily Protein Needs | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your daily protein needs for muscle gain, weight loss, or maintenance. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates daily protein requirement based on body weight and activity level or fitness goal.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據體重與活動量或健身目標，計算每日所需的蛋白質攝取量。

faq.q: How much protein do I need to build muscle?
faq.a: For muscle gain, it is generally recommended to consume 1.6 to 2.2 grams of protein per kilogram of body weight daily, combined with resistance training.

faq.q: Is it safe to consume a high-protein diet?
faq.a: For healthy individuals, a high-protein diet is generally safe. However, those with pre-existing kidney conditions should consult a doctor before increasing protein intake.

faq.q: Should I eat protein before or after a workout?
faq.a: Both are beneficial. Consuming protein around your workout window helps with muscle repair and growth. Total daily intake matters most.

tools.seo_title: Carb Intake Calculator - Daily Carbohydrates | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your daily carb intake easily! Free tool to plan your macros. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates daily carbohydrate grams based on total calories and target percentage (4 calories/gram).
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據總熱量與目標百分比計算每日碳水化合物克數（每克碳水含4大卡）。

faq.q: How many carbs should I eat per day?
faq.a: The Dietary Guidelines recommend that carbohydrates make up 45-65% of your total daily calories.

faq.q: Is this calculator suitable for keto diets?
faq.a: Yes, you can set a lower carbohydrate percentage (e.g., 5-10%) to calculate your daily carb limit for a ketogenic diet.

faq.q: Why divide by 4 in the formula?
faq.a: Each gram of carbohydrate provides approximately 4 calories, so dividing the carb calories by 4 gives the amount in grams.

tools.seo_title: Macro Ratio Calculator - Calculate Diet Macros | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your macronutrient ratio easily. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional. Try our free macro ratio calculator today!
tools.formula_latex: P_{cal} = P_g \times 4, C_{cal} = C_g \times 4, F_{cal} = F_g \times 9, R = \frac{E_{macro}}{E_{total}} \times 100\%
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates the percentage of total calories from protein, carbs, and fat using Atwater factors.
tools.formula_description_zh: 使用阿特沃特係數計算蛋白質、碳水化合物和脂肪佔總熱量的百分比。

faq.q: What is a good macro ratio for weight loss?
faq.a: A common macro ratio for weight loss is 40% protein, 30% carbs, and 30% fat, but it varies by individual. Consult a healthcare professional.

faq.q: How do I calculate my macro ratio?
faq.a: Multiply protein and carbs grams by 4, and fat grams by 9 to get calories. Then divide each by total calories and multiply by 100.

faq.q: Why is my macro ratio important?
faq.a: Your macro ratio helps ensure you get the right balance of nutrients for your fitness goals, whether it is muscle gain or fat loss.

tools.seo_title: Vitamin D Calculator - Daily IU Intake | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your daily Vitamin D needs based on age, skin color, and latitude. For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
secondary_keywords: how much vitamin d do i need
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates recommended Vitamin D intake based on base needs and deficiency adjustments.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據基礎需求與缺乏程度調整，計算每日建議維生素D攝取量。

faq.q: How much Vitamin D do I need daily?
faq.a: Most adults need 600-800 IU daily, but those with deficiency, darker skin, or living in northern latitudes may need 1000-4000 IU. Always consult your doctor.

faq.q: Can I get enough Vitamin D from the sun?
faq.a: Sunlight is a major source, but factors like sunscreen, latitude, and winter months often make supplementation necessary to maintain healthy levels.

faq.q: What are the symptoms of Vitamin D deficiency?
faq.a: Common symptoms include fatigue, bone pain, muscle weakness, and mood changes. A blood test is the best way to confirm a deficiency.

tools.seo_title: Fiber Intake Calculator - Daily Dietary Fiber | Free Tool
tools.seo_description: Calculate your daily fiber needs based on calories. Try our free tool! For informational purposes only. Consult a healthcare professional.
tools.formula_description_en: Calculates daily fiber needs based on 14 grams of fiber per 1,000 calories consumed.
tools.formula_description_zh: 根據每消耗1000大卡需要14克膳食纖維的標準，計算每日所需的纖維攝取量。

faq.q: How much fiber should I eat daily?
faq.a: The general recommendation is 38g per day for men and 25g per day for women, or 14g per 1,000 calories consumed.

faq.q: What are the best sources of dietary fiber?
faq.a: Whole grains, fruits, vegetables, legumes, nuts, and seeds are excellent sources of dietary fiber.

faq.q: Can I consume too much fiber?
faq.a: Yes, increasing fiber intake too quickly can cause bloating, gas, and cramps. It's best to increase it gradually and drink plenty of water.
